h10.

**`(*renderer).addArg` — `internal/filter/render.go:842` — approximately 28 inbound calls (from 14 distinct callers)**

How I got there: I extracted every function and method name declared in non-test files under `internal/` (370 symbols), counted identifier-followed-by-`(` occurrences across all non-test, non-generated Go files, then hand-verified the top hits to strip out names that collide with other packages (`New`, `Error`, `Next`, `Info`, `Kind` and similar were inflated by `err.Error()`, `rows.Next()`, `slog`, and goldmark interface methods).

`addArg` is the argument-binding helper for the SQL filter renderer: it appends a value to the renderer's arg slice and returns the dialect-appropriate placeholder. Because essentially every comparison, `IN`, `LIKE`, and regex branch has to bind a value, it's called 28 times from 14 different methods in the same file — `renderAccessorComparison`, `renderFunctionComparison`, `renderScalarComparison`, `renderJSONBoolComparison`, `renderTagInList`, `renderElementInCondition`, `renderScalarInCondition`, `renderRegex`, `foldedLike`, `elementPredicateSQL`, `renderTagEquals`, `renderTagStartsWith`, `buildJSONArrayLike`, and `addBoolArg` (`internal/filter/render.go:851`, which is itself just a thin wrapper over it).

One caveat on interpretation: all of `addArg`'s callers live inside `internal/filter/render.go`, so it wins on raw call-site count but is package-private. If you instead want the highest fan-in for a symbol called from *outside* its own package, the answer changes: `Schema.Field` (`internal/filter/schema.go:67`) has 19 call sites, though those are also within `internal/filter` (`parser.go` and `render.go`). The most-called `internal/` symbol reached from the rest of the backend is `util.GenUUID` (`internal/util/util.go:40`), with roughly 8 non-test callers spread across `server/router/api/v1` (session creation, access tokens, SSO usernames, shortcuts, attachment storage).

Runners-up under the same "all call sites" measure, for context: `jsonArrayExpr` at 16 (`internal/filter/render.go`), `renderChildren` at 14 (`internal/markdown/renderer`), and `getConstValue` at 13 (`internal/filter/parser.go`) — so the filter SQL renderer dominates the fan-in ranking generally.
